paper.original_reading: Read the complete public text of The Path of the Law and checked the original Harvard Law Review scan metadata. Review covers prediction theory, the bad-man analytic device, law/morals, contract, anti-formalism, history, statistics/economics, jurisprudence and representative later criticism. Digital-governance discussion is explicitly marked as a present-day reading extension.

classic.original_reading: Read the 1922 first-edition public text chapter by chapter: The Function of Legal Philosophy, The End of Law, The Application of Law, Liability, Property and Contract. The 1959 Yale revision is treated only as later version history and is not attributed back to the 1922 text.
